name: Claude Code
summary: Hands a coding job to the Claude Code CLI you already have installed, using your own login.

requires.why: To run the claude program that is already installed on this machine.
To work in a folder you have chosen. It reads and writes there, not anywhere else.
Because writing code means changing files in that folder.

settings.label: Project folder
settings.hint: The folder it may work in. It is run there, and it does not go outside it.

settings.label: The claude program
settings.hint: Leave empty and it looks on your PATH. Point at it if you installed it somewhere unusual.

settings.label: Give up after
settings.hint: Minutes. A coding job that has not finished by then is stopped.
